description: This file defines a generic service interface for managing entities within the system, providing methods for CRUD operations, refresh, count, and session management.

classes.name: SalesManagerEntityService
classes.description: A Java interface defining generic CRUD and management operations for entities, parameterized with entity type and ID type.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the entity into the database, with special considerations for triggers and listeners.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the existing entity in the database.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity record in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified entity from the database.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the state of the entity from the database.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by its identifier.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all entities of the specified type.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves an entity based on provided class and identifier.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the total number of entities of this type in the database.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the current session (likely persistence context).
